name: Aristotle North Pipeline

values.DataCenterNotes: Williams lists the Aristotle North Pipeline among the gas lines and plants for its Socrates power facilities in New Albany, Ohio. A June 2025 Pipeline and Gas Journal article says the Socrates plants serve a Meta data center and will get gas through two 24-inch pipelines to be filed later. The Williams page does not say outright which plant the North line serves, so the link runs through the Socrates project as a whole.

researcher_notes: No existing row matches. The roster has the sister lines Aristotle Central (P8312) and Aristotle South (P8313) but nothing named Aristotle North. Williams lists an Aristotle North Pipeline on its Socrates power facilities page, as one of the siting cases filed by Will-Power Pipeline OH, LLC, a Williams company. The Ohio Historic Preservation Office list of submissions for December 2025 shows an Aristotle North Pipeline Project sent by the Ohio Power Siting Board on December 19 2025. That filing is the concrete step. The case number 25-1163-GA-BLN comes from the consolidator and from a link on the Williams page, and the state docket page could not be read, so the filing itself was not seen. Length, diameter, endpoints, capacity and route were not found, so those cells are blank and the route is marked as none. Ohio is stated by the state agency, and the county is not given, so Delaware County is a guess and is not entered. Data center tag: the Pipeline and Gas Journal article names the Meta data center and the Socrates plants but does not name the North line. The Williams page names the line but does not mention a data center beside it. The tag rests on the line being part of the Socrates project, as with the Central and South lines. Confidence is low until the filing is read. Owner entity Will-Power Pipeline OH LLC already exists in the ownership list with this spelling.
